integrity: A self-contained rational-arithmetic checker is included. Its finite checks corroborate rather than prove the infinite theorem. All substantial universal assertions have written algebraic arguments.
scientific_limitations: Scalar autonomous linear decay, independent parameter draws and exact tableau. The third-order identities under altered sampling concern expectation of RK conditions, not a global low-regularity convergence order. Zero multipliers are not strictly positive. Wider multidimensional/nonlinear behavior and scientific priority are not certified.
title: A sharp positivity-risk frontier for randomized A-stable SDIRK integration
